scientific_integrity: The Poisson bound and almost-sure extreme scale have a self-contained proof except for the explicitly cited 1989 Chen--Stein theorem. Fixed equal-weight moving-average descent-pattern probabilities are prior art and are not claimed as new. Finite exhaustive tests provide corroboration, not proof of infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Iid atomless innovations; equal two-point weights only; Poisson limit at growing thresholds with bounded expected count and r=o(sqrt(n)); no universal centered longest-streak limit or extension to unequal weights. Historical priority and independent scientific assessment remain open.
title: Poisson extremes for alternating streaks of two-point moving averages
